opportunities.title: University of Macau students
opportunities.bodyMarkdown:
Students interested in pursuing a PhD with the principal investigator are required to first apply for a Research Assistant position.

A minimum of one year of research collaboration, such as RA work and thesis supervision, is required before formal PhD admission.

Send your CV and UM transcript directly by email.
requirements: An A grade in at least one course taught by the principal investigator, or an overall UM GPA of at least 3.7.
Strong commitment and dedication to research.

opportunities.title: Applicants from other institutions
opportunities.summary: Direct PhD admission through an advisor recommendation.
opportunities.bodyMarkdown:
External candidates are not recruited for RA positions. In principle, external PhD applicants are not accepted; exceptions may be considered when recommended by their advisor.

A short-term collaborative research project may be required to assess compatibility with the group.

siteSettings.name: CASINO Lab
siteSettings.introduction: Research in information security, human–computer interaction, and the intersection of computing and society.
siteSettings.aboutMarkdown:
CASINO Lab, formerly Cyber and Crypto Lab (CRAB), is headed by Kanye Ye Wang at the University of Macau.

Department of Computer and Information Science
Department of Finance and Business Economics

In 2025, the group achieved the top-four security “grand slam”. We welcome interdisciplinary collaborations.
siteSettings.recruitmentMarkdown:
Application timeline
Fall intake: apply by mid-March. Spring intake: apply by the end of July of the previous year. Confirm the current university deadlines before applying. Contact the principal investigator before applying through the university system.

Program structure
Expected duration: four years, including a qualifying exam at the end of the first year.

Funding
The lab’s published guidance lists a monthly stipend of MOP 12,500–20,000. Each advisor may nominate one student per year for the MOP 20,000 scholarship; the guidance reports that fewer than 5% receive this top-tier scholarship. Check the current call for eligibility and funding details.
